extDescription.message: Send links, videos and files from your browser to the FastDM desktop app.

notRunningHint.message: Start the FastDM app, then try again.

notPairedHint.message: Connect this browser to FastDM. You will be asked to approve it in the FastDM window.

waitingApproval.message: Waiting for approval in the FastDM window…

errPairingDenied.message: The connection was denied in FastDM.

errPairingTimeout.message: No answer from FastDM. Please try again.

errPairingBusy.message: Another connection request is already waiting in FastDM.

errGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

emptyHint.message: Right-click a link and choose “Download with FastDM”.

optionsPrivacy.message: This extension only talks to the FastDM app on your own computer (127.0.0.1). It does not send data to any server.
